serving_geometry_basis: Raw-audio direct cells on build 04ccc72a with the bf16 mmproj loaded. -np 2, applying the preregistration section 8 rule against the MEASURED prompt fit of 2026-09-04 (docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-04-a2t-direct-calibration-400-v1/prompt-fit/prompt-fit.json): the native tool-calling envelope renders to 13,914 text tokens through the pinned template -- 678 MORE than the 13,236-token legacy registry text, not fewer -- so the A1 worst request needs 13,914 + 468 measured speech tokens + 1,024 completion ceiling + 2 special = 15,408 tokens. That exceeds the 14,800-token threshold at which the rule requires -np 2, and it left only 976 tokens of margin in a 16,384-token slot. At -c 49152 / -np 2 each slot holds 24,576 tokens, a margin of 9,168 for A1 and 9,846 for A0'. core.flight.FlightRuntime.serve derives -np/-c from the adapter's serving_geometry(), so slots x slot_tokens must equal the -c above exactly; 24,576 is a multiple of 512 and the server does not round it.
